title: Design: A/P Detail links are blue, semi-bold and not underlined
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an open bill received on a delivery at your current location on today's date, so its number shows as a link.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • Open Work In Progress (Reports, then "Work In Progress" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, so its links can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the document numbers that are links and compare them with the links on Work In Progress.
  2. Press Tab until a link has keyboard focus.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • They are blue, the same blue as the links on Work In Progress, semi-bold and not underlined.

Step 2:

  • The focused link is underlined.
  • Links are underlined only on keyboard focus.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-open-balance-pinned-light.png: figure "Open Balance pinned, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7." (caption of "Open Balance pinned, light")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05), closed: PRD version 5 said "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today; the design pictures will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 9). The held design-version case D-80 (C715562) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
